Reviewed actor/session propagation, explicit owner query/body for create-property, shared transactional invariants and module providers. Same 34 controllers, 177 handlers, 296 routes and 38 modules; no tool publication. Signature/delegate lines refreshed from AST.

Four controller-free local modules separate shared authorization, conversation, run and runtime persistence. Existing 34 controllers, 177 handlers and 296 routes unchanged; no chat endpoint, assignment, inference or MCP tool published.

Eight authenticated conversation coordination handlers are real HTTP routes, separate from the unchanged 177-handler domain/secure-flow inventory and unpublished MCP catalog. Admission/retention, worker support, exact adapter/context policy and authority clock updates are traced without production-readiness claims.

Authorized configuration catalog and non-generative exact-selection eligibility; backward bounded latest message windows. Ten coordination routes remain separate from unchanged domain tool catalog, no automatic MCP attestation.
Typed capability registry and authorized capability discovery/schema routes. Domain operations remain subject to explicit approved publication/bindings; this source inventory never enables MCP tools.

AI-15 typed59 local reads, five external read boundaries, three private regenerable artifact references, inherited transactions and reauthorized results. The complete72-tool private transport is measured; dynamic modules and the authenticated artifact-download route are inventoried without claiming publication or live Gemini acceptance. Source inventory never enables tools.
